# Scenario: project-local bind policy rejects project root, metadata mounts
# (.env / docker-compose.yml), and missing Git sources. Each bad cycle
# soft-fails with security_violation / disallowed_bind_mount; prior healthy
# container stays running. README Strict Volume & Socket Control.
# Traversal / symlink cases live in sibling project_local_bind_reject_*.txt.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline without forbidden binds'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: healthy stack ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plrej-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.root.yml dev/e2e-plrej/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: project root bind'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: ./ root rejected ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
grep 'disallowed_bind_mount' $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plrej-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.env.yml dev/e2e-plrej/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: mount project .env'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 3: ./.env rejected ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plrej-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.compose-file.yml dev/e2e-plrej/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: mount docker-compose.yml'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 4: ./docker-compose.yml rejected ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plrej-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.missing.yml dev/e2e-plrej/docker-compose.yml
exec git add -A .
exec git commit -m 'fix: bind missing Git source'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 5: missing source rejected before compose up ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plrej-web
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plrej/missing.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-plrej
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9983
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plrej/.env --
SECRET=should-not-mount

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plrej/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- compose.root.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ./:/app:ro

-- compose.env.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ./.env:/app/.env:ro

-- compose.compose-file.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ./docker-compose.yml:/app/compose.yml:ro

-- compose.missing.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ./missing.yml:/etc/app/missing.yml:ro

-- .env --
